integrity: The infinite theorem is proved by binary Schur elimination, exact path nullity counts, marked cyclic-run enumeration, and a six-element transfer-group identity. Reproducibility uses bundled standalone Python 3 source and deterministic output. No independent audit has been conducted.
limitations: Only simple sunlet graphs C_n corona K_1 of cycle order n>=3 over GF(2); no all-unicyclic extension or general-field assertion. Computational checks are finite. Bibliographic comparisons of accessible publications do not guarantee priority over unindexed work.
title: Rational partial Petrial genus enumerator for sunlet graphs
